avis.titre: I always continue to use  Shishedo products.
avis.texte: Love the Ultimune Power Infusing Serum with other Shishedo products. It helps keep my skin hydrated all day long for a fresher look. My only issue with the purchase of this product is that all of the Ulta retail stores do not carry this great line for me

avis.titre: I will buy this product again
avis.texte: This is an amazing product, my skin feels very soft and well rested after using it.

I use the Ultimate Power Infusing Serum daily as part of my morning routine. It helps to keep my skin hydrated and 'glowy'. It also leaves a bit of a shine which is something I wouldn't expect for two reasons; one I live in the Arizona desert and two my age of beyond 70yo.

I received this in exchange for my honest review, and overall I really enjoyed this serum. It's very lightweight, absorbs quickly, and has a really lovely smell that's not too strong or overpowering. My skin is plump and glowy after using, I've especially been loving it after being out in the sun. Works well with my moisturizer and sits nicely under makeup (no pilling). Overall would recommend and buy again.

avis.titre: I will definitely purchase this product again
avis.texte: I use this product to hydrate my skin after cleansing it. This is to refill as I use this very often.

avis.titre: I would definitely buy this product again
avis.texte: I love using this product to hydrate my skin. Keep my skin looking glowing.

I use this serum daily after I wash my face and use Essence - followed by the vital perfection cream. This product feel luxury on my face and does not make me break out like other serums have done in the past.
I've been using this for 3 years now. Definitely my pores are smaller than 3 years ago and keep that way even hot and humid day. Love it!
Seems to improve the appearance of my skin. Calmer and brighter skin.
Seems to improve the appearance of my skin. Calmer and brighter skin.

avis.titre: Shiny, Smells fantastic, but instructions could be clearer!
avis.texte: I really enjoy using this product. The fragrance is beautiful, and it feels incredibly luxurious and hydrating on the skin. However, I'm docking one star because it's genuinely confusing to figure out exactly when to apply it in my skincare routine. It would be incredibly helpful if the packaging clearly stated where this fits in with toners and other serums. Overall, it's a great product once you figure out how to use it!
A serum that soothes and nourishes my skin and helps it feel and look hydrated with the benefits of nutrients.
Very good formulation and so light on the skin amd it dries up too.
Amazing product will be spreading the word on this one. To good to keep to myself.
I can honestly say I gave this serum a chance. I saw NO change, no results. Was like putting wet stuff on my face with no change. Complete waste of money for me.
My morning routine after shower. Keeps my face young and fresh.

avis.titre: Not certain if I am seeing results
avis.texte: I have used this serum out of habit not sure if I am getting in results but I try anything to combat my dry skin. I use this in conjunction with the heavy moisturizer by Shisedo

avis.titre: Brightened and refreshed with this serum
avis.texte: I have been using this serum for about a year and see improvement in my skin. Brightened and refreshed.

This is the first product I've ever tried from Shisedo, and I was pleasantly surprised. There is a light, clean, pleasant scent and a lightweight texture. I have combination skin and live in a hot, humid climate, which means I need a hydrating product - this hydrated without overdoing it. I think this would work for most skin types, but if you have really dry skin you'd probably need to make sure to add a heavier cream moisturizer on top. Overall, I definitely recommend this to most people looking for a hydration step in their skincare routine that also adds some nice anti-aging effects.
I've been using this product daily for the last 11 years. It's super hydrating.

avis.titre: I would buy this product again and again
avis.texte: I have been using ultimune power infusing serum for many years. Without it, my routine skin care will not be completed.

My skin is do much better since using this serum. I do not have redness and my little bit of wrinkles I have appear gone when using tge serum. I have sensitive skin and I have no isdues at all using the serum. Will keep buying.
I have been using this one to slow down skin aging, so far, so good. I love Shiseido products ❤️

I decided to order the "refill" to replace the original bottle that I had purchased a while back. I was disappointed as not only is the refill smaller, but the top does not fit and the pumper is also to long. Proving that Shiseido is advertising and selling the 75ml bottle that is NOT truly 75ml. Shame on Shiseido!!!

avis.titre: I have bought this product over and over again.
avis.texte: I have used Shiseido products since I was 20. I am now 74. Still love the products.

avis.titre: No visible result, can not use around eyes
avis.texte: I am using it twice a day as instructed, but have not seen any visible result. And it caused my skin around eyes swell.

I'm 45 and have been using this product since my early 30s. Ultimune is the secret to graceful aging - I think that I look well-rested and glowing, with firm, evenly-toned skin. I'm super-pleased with my my face, and the price point is amazing considering the quality. This is one of the few quality skin care products I've been able to afford throughout my career! Pic is no makeup, no fillers, and no Botox. Thank you, Shiseido!

avis.titre: I got it as a gift with purchase but will buy in full size!
avis.texte: I use it after my softener and ultimune! Makes my skin supple and glowy!
Use this product twice every day .my skin soaks it up, feels so smooth and I see an immediate improvement. My favorite.
I use it once daily during night time. It has helped improve my skin texture. Would definitely include it in my skin care ritual.
I love the Ultimune Power Infusing Serum by Shiseido! It's lightweight, absorbs quickly, and makes my skin feel smooth, hydrated, and radiant. My skin looks healthier overall—definitely worth it!

avis.titre: Definitely worth it!  My skin is even toned and radiant
avis.texte: I use this serum twice a day - after washing my face in the morning and at night before bed. It is the 1st layer before the benefiance cream, and together, they work perfectly to smooth and hydrate my dry/normal skin.

First, I got a small sample at the department store. I tried it at night and the next day, I could see the big difference around my eyes! I bought three big bottles and skin toner, also cream from Shiseido. my skin has been very hydrated since then! Highly recommend.

I've used this serum for a couple of years now. Normally I would have to rotate a product with another similar product due to allergies: I don't have to do that with this serum! It feels wonderful going on - cooling & soothing, well worth the money!
Love this product, been using it for several years now and everyone comments on how nice my skin looks.
Serum is great but unfortunately the refill bottle doesn't fit the original bottle which is… the whole purpose of buying this bottle…

Let me just begin by saying that I did not buy this from Ulta I received a sample in an order from them. Second, I NEVER use anything on my face unless I go in the sun, then just sunscreen. I use eye cream only, currently Lancome. I have oily skin and don't really wear a lot of makeup; powder, blush, highlighter and always lipstick. I decided to use a little of this this morning before work and of course the above-mentioned makeup. All I can say is wow. I won't review something unless it's something that really makes a difference. However my face actually looked and still looks (10 hours later) smooth, a little brighter and I can't believe I'm saying this, but, a little younger! I will be buying this immediately.

avis.titre: I would buy this product again and again
avis.texte: I have been using this product for many years, Shiseido brand never disappoints.
This is a nice thick consistency adding hydration to my skin. Feels very nice on my skin and keeps my skin youthful looking.
I love how it makes my skin feel so dewy. I feel like it is helping my skin be at its best!
I took a break from it and regretted it. Now I'm back, very satisfied with it as always.

I can't say enough about this serum. I apply this after my toner and even after a face mask and it still brings my skin to a higher level of softness! I love this product, and it is now a daily need in my face care routine. I even have my husband using it!

I bought a small bottle of this a while back and absolutely loved how my face felt when using it daily. It's a bit of a splurge for me. But, really worth it. I also have a lot of allergies and this causes no problems.

avis.titre: Using this for many years and it's still a favorite
avis.texte: Every day lotion. Very refreshing. Long time fan. Little bit goes far.
Use it daily for many years . It works very well on my sensitive skin and kept my wrinkles under control.

I received this free in exchange for my honest review and given the brand name and product claims, was super excited. I used this power serum morning and night as suggested. To me it's more of a silky, lovely moisturizing serum than one with "power" benefits. Perhaps it takes more than one bottle to see results but it's far too expensive for just a moisturizing serum and I didn't repurchase. That being said, it does feel great on. It compliments my moisturizer and while I didn't see glaring results, it did leave my skin a bit more radiant after application. The serum absorbs well and fairly quickly and I didn't have any problems under my makeup. Aside from the cost vs results, the packaging is really annoying. First, the lid is huge compared to be bottle, which is unnecessary and wasteful. Secondly being a large glass bottle with a large lid, it takes up a lot of space and doesn't travel well. Overall, it was just.. ok. Fine. But not something I fell in love with enough to buy again.
I received a sample from Ulta and now I have a new item to add to my regular regime!
This really made my face feel nice and soft and hydrated! I love how my fave felt afterward!

I used this product for two days. It is very lightweight and absorbs easily. I noticed my skin looked smoother. The formula is not greasy and feels great. I am a 70-year-old black female with combination skin (oily/normal)

This product made my life change, I was insecure about my large pores, redness, and dull looks, but after i used all sheshiedo products makes my face brighter, glowy , and even have a glass skin the one i wanted. Been using this for 2 years now and i will keep buying it ! Make sure you buy the set for you to achieve glowy and glass skin.

I received this full size from Bzz Agent for my honest review. And I honestly will say I love it! It is the most luxurious hydrating serum. I use it right after my toner and before my moisturizer and it leaves a beautiful dewy glow. And as a bonus, it does not pill under make up. I will definitely repurchase this in the future.

I really like all of the amazing benefits of using Shiseido Ultimune Power Infusing Serum 4.0. It is super easy to apply and goes on easy without leaving your skin sticky. I haven't had issues with irritation either

Overall I've enjoyed using this serum. It has a light scent and absorbs well into my skin. My skin is very dry, so finding products that are hydrating is always a plus. I've noticed a slight improvement in fine lines on my face and brightness and will continue to use. I received this product in exchange for my review.
I use this product before my actives and like the way it feels on my skin. I use it instead of a primer and will likely continue using it to prep my skin for my actives

Great serum! Makes my skin feel soft and hydrated, without making it feel oily. Works well with other skincare products as well as my makeup. My skin can tend to get dry and this product helps keep my skin hydrated. I used it day and night and absolutely love it! Highly recommend this premium product.
I loved my good looking skin after using this product. Glow, soft and smooth!!

his is a nice serum. Serums usually go on as a step before the moisturizer. The feel of this is nice. It has a watery texture initially. That's not a bad thing, as it doesn't take but a few dots to cover your face. I think it may last a long time. It has a soft and light feel, almost reminding me of the texture of a bit of aloe water. It's not creamy or heavy, which is good, because it can be used as a step in the morning skincare routine, prior to moisturizing and makeup, etc. A little stickiness lingers, but it's not bad and feels as though it coats my skin, making it a bit more vibrant and softer. Using it twice a seems to help my fine lines, especially ones I get from sleeping. (Think fine lines from holding the pillow against my face). My skin has more of a matt looking finish when I'm using it. In other words, I feel like my skin is looking overall smoother. It hasn't seemed to clog my pours or break me out any. There are some cool plant based ingredients in there as well, which adds to the luxury, in my opinion. The scent is very faint and it doesn't feel overwhelming or bothersome. A bit of a bonus is the glass bottle looks sleek on my bathroom cabinet.

This prestigious power infusing serum is perfectly designed to suit all skin types at all times in all environments. It's light weighted consistency is easily absorbed into your skin, leaving your skin feeling hydrated and soft rather than sticky or greasy!

As a mom about to enter her 40's, age correction skin care is paramount. Shiseido has brought another stunning serum that boasts its revitalization and means it. The ultimune serum is so soft and leaves my skin well hydrated. It perfects fine lines and leaves a supple, youthful look. Paired with Shiseido moisturizer, this serum is a home run. 5 stars!

avis.titre: Nice Scent but not much improvement
avis.texte: This is a nice facial serum but unfortunatley I did not notice much improvement in my skin while using this. I typically love Shiseido products but this just wasn't effective for me. The serum has a comfortable, lightweight feel on my skin and has a great scent. Its not sticky or irritating which I like but didn't notice any improvement in my fine lines or wrinkles. My skin does feel softer overall and I will continue using this product until I finish the bottle but I would not buy another once it runs out. Thanks to Shiseido for sending me this product complimentary to try out in exchange for my honest review.

I loved this serum, it's lightweight so you can use it under makeup with no issues, left my skin radiant and moisturized, you only need 2 pumps for all your face and absorbs quickly leaving you a nice glow without making you look oily

Great serum. Makes my skin feel soft and hydrated. Works well with other skincare products as well as makeup. My skin is dry so this product helps with that. Can be used day and night. Overall it is good.

I highly enjoy the Ultimune Power Infusing Serum. It makes my skin soft and hasn't made my face break out. My skin can be sensitive and I've had no reactions at all. I highly recommend you try this product for yourselves.

The serum is such a lightweight consistency that sinks easily into the skin. I use this serum after cleansing and toning my face (morning and night) and I've noticed that my skin is much softer and supple. It adds more elasticity and is great for those with dry or dehydrated skin! It a thinner consistency that doesn't feel heavy or greasy!

I am an avid user of Shiseido products because my mom uses them and has used them for at least 15 years. I received this sample and I already knew this was going to be good for skin. I like the way my skin has been feeling. Fresh and clean and soft! It gives it a dewey look and it stays that way. There is no heavy scent or itchiness. I like that you do not have to use a lot of it, just 1-2 pumps for your whole face and it will get a bit of your neck too!

I recently tried the Shiseido Ultimune Power Infusing Serum, and it has completely transformed my skincare routine. From the very first application, my skin felt noticeably smoother, more hydrated, and visibly radiant. Even my husband, who's usually not into skincare, started using it—and now he's hooked! We're both in our 40s, and we've noticed a real difference in how healthy and firm our skin looks. The serum absorbs quickly, has a luxurious feel, and layers perfectly with other products. It's rare to find something we both love, but this one's definitely a shared favorite in our bathroom.

Shiseido is a brand that I love and trust with my skin, so I was very happy to try this serum. The first thing I noticed is that it didn't break me out. No irritation, no redness. After a few days, my skin felt a little softer and smoother. After a bit over a week, my skin seemed to glow a little more. There is hardly any scent, and the texture and consistency results in just two pumps covering my face and neck. I will be buying another bottle when I run out!

avis.titre: My make up goes on much better!
avis.texte: I started using this about a month ago and I am so impressed! I have used products from Shiseido in the past, so this did not disappoint! My skin is nice and even, and make up goes on smoothly.
I knew I would love this serum once I felt the consistency. It's not too thick or too runny. Makes your face feel and look so smooth. It has a slight fragrance but didn't irritate my skin at all.

've been using the Shiseido Ultimune Power Infusing Serum for a few weeks now, and I'm really enjoying it. The scent is light and pleasant—just enough to feel luxurious without being overpowering. It glides on so smoothly and absorbs quickly, which I love for both my morning and nighttime routines. After using it, my skin feels fresh, hydrated, and noticeably bouncier. It's become a staple in my routine, and I can already see a difference in how plump and healthy my skin looks.

It makes my skin look like glass and is so plumping! I love that it quickly absorbs into the skin without feeling too sticky or watery. It has a nice texture and feels lightweight. I use this as the first step to my skin care routine
Not sure what is in this serum but I'm not sure how I lived without it. Elevated my skincare routine. Helped my other skincare products. Definitely a solid add to my lineup.

Shiseido Ultimune Power Infusing Serum has truly transformed my skincare routine! From the moment I applied it, I noticed a silky-smooth texture that absorbed super easily, leaving my skin feeling hydrated and rejuvenated. Over time, my complexion has appeared more radiant and firm. As a bonus, my fine lines noticeably diminished. I love how lightweight the serum is—it layers nicely under moisturizer and makeup. The elegant, subtle fragrance adds a luxurious touch to my daily ritual. Feels like I'm at the spa!

A lightweight, fast-absorbing serum that strengthens the skin barrier, boosts hydration, and enhances radiance. Powered by antioxidant-rich ingredients like reishi mushroom and iris root, it leaves skin smoother and more resilient within days. Ideal for dull or dry skin.

I really thought this was a great product. It does everything it says it does. My skin felt quenched, it was light and I enjoyed the results. However, I did not care for the smell. It is perfumed and is a bit strong for my taste. I am not against perfumed products in general, this one just wasn't my cup of tea. It does dissipate quickly so you're not left with a lingering smell. So, if you want the results and do not have sensitivity to smells, I would definitely give this a try. It delivers on everything it promises!

avis.titre: I Like How My Skin Feels
avis.texte: Since I've been using this, I have noticed an improvement in the texture of my skin.

I was excited when I received this serum in exchange for my honest review… it seemed like something that would be easy to integrate into my routine and it was! It's s nice lightweight serum that doesn't feel greasy at all. I apply it morning and evening with my other serums. It absorbs nicely and lays well under makeup. It doesnt cause any pilling which is always a concern I have when introducing a new skincare product. I cant say that I see any specific improvements just yet but my skin just seems to look better. I can't pinpoint why but it's just better. I look forward to seeing what additional improvements occur as I continue to use it. **One small note… it is somewhat perfumed. I don't mind it at all but if you have allergies or sensitivities to fragrance, it's something to keep in mind

*Received free in exchange for honest review I've used this serum for a month and am pretty impressed. It's lightweight, sinks in quickly, plays well with other products and despite the faint fragrance, never caused any irritation to my ultra sensitive and reactive skin. I noticed less redness within the first week and over time, my skin is softer and more even in tone. I don't see much difference in fine lines this soon but I have high hopes as I keep using. I definitely recommend.

Love this serum by Shiseido! It applies effortlessly and absorbs nicely into the skin. It wears wonderful under makeup and doesn't pill with other products. It leaves my skin very hydrated and dewy for that "glass-skin" look. It does have a slight fragrance but it isn't overwhelming. I would definitely recommend for anyone with dry skin and I would repurchase.

I really liked this serum. It was non greasy, and did seem to lighten spots and hydrate. I didn't notice much help on the fine lines, but I think with daily use it may help. It didn't break me out like other serums can and it worked nicely with my moisturizer. It didn't burn my skin either, so it wasn't too strong

This is probably a TMI review but I used this serum morning and night after my mother passed and while I couldn't do much, this serum helped me feel like I was doing something. My face felt really plump and healthy and I have super sensitive skin that normally reacts to everything but it didn't react to this. I was gifted this product for my review but I would and absolutely will be buying this when I run out.
This product has brighten my skin and reduced the texture in my skin while keeping my skin moisturized without making me look like a grease ball.

avis.titre: I love this product! Def going to rebuy!
avis.texte: I love how this product goes on my skin, it leaves it so nice and smooth. It also has a nice fragrance, not strong. The package is so luxs also! I use it every morning and night. I wake up with soft skin
I've added this serum to my daily routine since trying this product out. This product helped my skin appear brighter, tighter, and more hydrated. I will continue to use this product in the future.

I have really enjoyed using this serum! It feels very rich when applying to the skin and the packaging also is very heavy and nice! My skin has felt so moisturized and plump after using this for a couple of weeks.

I've been using this daily for approximately two weeks, and I love it. Shiseido sent me this free sample through the BzzAgent sampling program. From day one I was impressed with how plumping & moisturizing it is. But what really blew me away is its calming abilities after doing some serious exfoliation. I've never had a product literally snap by skin barrier back in shape so quickly! Bottom line is, it works and I've had great results. It's another amazing product from a trusted brand.

avis.titre: I would buy this over and over again!
avis.texte: This serum has cleared some of my blemishes and leaves my skin feeling smooth and radiant.

avis.titre: Feeling the Difference: Ultimune Power Infusing Serum Review
avis.texte: If you're looking for an instant boost in skin hydration and softness, look no further than the Ultimune Power Infusing Serum. From the moment I started using it, my skin has felt incredibly supple and looked so much more hydrated. It's one of those products where you truly feel the difference – my skin simply doesn't feel as good when I miss a day. While I haven't observed any changes in my fine lines yet, the immediate improvement in skin texture is impressive, and I'm hopeful for more results over time.

avis.auteur: Good but test wasn't long enough
avis.titre: Felt good but didn't see a huge difference
avis.texte: This product felt good on but I didn't see a ton of results. Once it dried it felt good. It doesn't leave any film or sticky feel. I would need to try this product longer than this test allowed to see if there are results.

I've been using this product consistently for the past couple of weeks and overall, I liked it so much. It keeps my skin hydrated and smooth and healthy. I don't have a sensitive skin and it did good on my skin, it has fragrance and it was okay with me

avis.titre: One Month In — I Love It!
avis.texte: I've been using the Shiseido Ultimune Power Infusing Serum for the past month and I'm genuinely impressed. From the first use, I noticed how luxurious the texture felt — it's silky, lightweight, and absorbs quickly without leaving any stickiness.

I enjoyed trying this product. I received it for free for my review. The consistency of the serum is nice. It goes on easily and only feels a little sticky until it fully soaks into the skin. I do not think it is overly hydrating and I would love to try some of the other products in this line to help with that. I do believe it has softened my skin and my fine lines. The smell is amazing. It's a light floral scent, not overpowering but very pleasant. I absolutely love it. You can tell this is a high-end product and it feels luxurious on. I gave four stars because I only tried the serum and did feel like I needed additional lotion and eye cream to be fully hydrated. I would purchase the Shiseido Ultimune serum again and am looking forward to trying the eye cream and a lotion as well.

✨OBSESSED I've been using the Shiseido Ultimune Power Infusing Serum and I am completely in love. Within 30 minutes of applying it, I can literally see a difference in my skin. I'm talking smoother texture, more bounce, and a healthy glow I didn't even know I was missing. 🙌🏼

I delayed reviewing this product, as I like to give skincare a decent amount of time to do it's thing before I decide if I really like it or not. Boy, am I glad I did because this product took a minute to show it's stuff. I'm a skincare snob of sorts, so it's difficult to impress me. I've tried high end and low end and everything in between. Despite all my products, age has gotten the best of me and my complexion has gone from combination skin, leaning toward a bit oily, to very dry, with these weird dry patches around the perimeter of my face (forehead, outer cheeks, chin) that are very difficult to keep moisturized. Well let me tell you, this serum has done the trick. I actually can't believe it! After 1 week, I noticed some change, but the patches were still there when I would wake up in the morning. But after 2 weeks, I was floored. The patches of weird, dry skin were gone! Completely moisturized! Wow! I have tried many serums, and although some of them have accomplished an improvement in my new found skin problems, none of them have completely cleared them up like this product! Very impressed and will definitely continue using!
Product absorbs quickly and was moisturizing to the skin. Didn't notice much of a result, but it didn't cause any breakouts. Wouldn't buy it for full price.

This product is of a high quality. It seemed to leave my skin smoother and improved the overall texture and coloring. However, it did seem to cause some small minor breakouts, so perhaps this would be better on aging skin.

I've been using the Shiseido Ultimune Power Infusing Serum for and I can honestly say it lives up to the hype. The texture is lightweight and silky, and it absorbs quickly without leaving any sticky residue. My skin feels noticeably smoother, more hydrated, and just healthier overall. There's a visible glow that's hard to ignore! What I really love is how it layers perfectly with other products in my routine—no pilling or irritation, which is a big plus for my sensitive skin. The scent is light and pleasant too, not overpowering at all. I'm giving it 4.5 stars only because the price is on the higher side, but the results definitely make it worth it. I will definitely be purchasing this again. Highly recommend if you're looking to level up your skincare game!

avis.titre: Love Shiseido products, this one included!
avis.texte: As many others have mentioned, Shiseido does use fragrance in their skin care. I usually lean towards fragrance free, but I've had such great experiences with other Shiseido products that I am willing to overlook the fragrance aspect. My main skin concerns were hyperpigmentation and dryness, and this product has worked well for both of those concerns. I pair it with a retinol for an extra boost.
The serum goes on smoothly but is a bit sticky when you first put it on. It dries off to a silky texture within a moment and has a pleasant scent. My skin felt more hydrated and dewy while using it.

I started using this serum 3 weeks ago and I love it! Compared to other serums, this one beats them all. I have noticed a change in my skin texture and my skin looks more glowing and more hydrated! I noticed the biggest difference around my area where I always have patches of dryness. They are no longer there! It has helped the appearance of my fine lines and redness, too. The serum does not have a strong perfume odor, which I love! I consider this to be a great addition to my skin care routine and would definitely recommend it to friends and family. I received this product in exchange for an honest review.
I got the sample and love their texture. It's not too thick so it's easy to absorb on my skin. The smell is not too strong is also a good point because I am pregnant. Definitely will buy it again!

avis.titre: Skin is left feeling youthful and brightened
avis.texte: Wow, I love everything about this serum! It smells amazing, a bit like citrus! I apply am and pm and my skin feels so moisturizing and brightened and I do see a visible difference in less fine line and wrinkles! I also love that the bottle is refillable and uses 93% less waste! Save the environment while looking youthful! Love it!
